Pacaya is a volcanic complex approximately 67 km from Antigua. The main crater stands at an elevation of 2552 m. The volcanic landscape includes cones and craters; Caldera Lagoon, covering about 35 hectares, lies in the park area. A visit to the lagoon itself is not included in this excursion.

The route requires the ability to hike uphill, gaining approximately 400 m in elevation. An ascent to the summit of the main crater is not part of the itinerary.

## Three sides of the capital in one excursion

We begin with a panoramic drive along Balboa Avenue and through the modern neighbourhoods of [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/). Then we introduce you to historic [Casco Antiguo](/panama/place/casco-viejo/), show you [San José Church and its Golden Altar](/panama/place/san-jose-church/) and visit [Panamá Viejo](/panama/place/panama-viejo/).

We arrange a six-hour private tour with English-speaking guides, bus transport and waiting time for up to 6 hours. Admission to San José Church and the Panamá La Vieja historic complex is included.

On the seven-day corporate trip, we run this excursion after the morning visit to Gamboa. We coordinate the order and timing of stops with your group's schedule.

At the locks, you will watch the gates in operation and ships passing through. The IMAX cinema screens a three-dimensional film about the construction and operation of the Panama Canal. The film runs for 45 minutes, is presented in English with Spanish subtitles, and is narrated by Morgan Freeman.

The tour continues through a residential neighbourhood in the former American Canal Zone and along Balboa Avenue beside Panama Bay. In the old district of Casco Antiguo, you will see narrow streets, squares and parks, walk through Plaza de Francia and visit San José Church with its Golden Altar.

The city portion ends on the Amador Causeway, which connects Naos, Perico and Flamenco islands.
